summary: Short kerb on a narrow bush-lined lane; apartments 16 m away.
reasons: Only 9 m of kerb, tight room

best_section.where: West edge of Bryce Street, just north of the footpath junction beside the bush

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the east side. Apartments are 16 m away on the west, set back behind trees and a footpath.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with a footpath along the west edge; the 9 m section only just fits a van and parked cars sit nearby, so room is tight.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the lane, though 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Low-lying: minimum elevation 5.6 m, Brisbane River 263 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the lane, especially from the east; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: True lane width between trees and footpath
